text:
sophia: Heads-up — nightly eval showed a big metric spike for quantized-v2 on commons-bench. Looks like a bunch of prompts leaked into eval. Can someone sanity-check?

eval-bot: Completed eval job quantized-v2 @1782003000 — regression detected: accuracy -4.2% vs baseline fp16. Job: /runs/4721. Attached artifact: /artifacts/4721/fixtures.json

liam: Is that leakage or a flaky runner? Any changes to fixture generation or CI seeds recently?

sophia: I pulled the fixtures and diffed them. The synthetic generator changed in PR #238 — it now reuses a Random() instance across shards without seeding per-shard. That can cause overlapping prompt orders across splits.

perry: Oof. I touched the shard loop in runner a few weeks ago (perf micro-optim). Did I accidentally remove the seed propagation?

sophia: Possibly. Here's the problematic snippet from fixtures/generate.py I found in the new branch:

```python
# fixtures/generate.py
import random
# old: rng = random.Random(seed)
rng = random.Random()
for shard in shards:
    rng.shuffle(prompts)
    write_shard(shard, prompts[:per_shard])
```

liam: If rng is unseeded and shared across shards, different test machines + CI runs can get different splits. But also if runner expects per-shard deterministic seeds we'll see cross-run variance.

perry: I also noticed runner.py reads env var SHARD_SEED in one place and SEED in another — mismatch could mean the per-shard seed isn't set at all in CI. Quick grep:

```bash
# CI sets:
export SEED=12345
export SHARD_INDEX=2
# runner expects: os.environ.get('SHARD_SEED')
```

marie: I opened PR #241 with two fixes: (1) generator uses random.Random(seed + shard_index) for each shard, (2) runner env var names normalized to SEED and SHARD_INDEX. Also added a unit test to assert no duplicate prompt ids across train/val/test splits.

perry: Nice. I'll review the PR. Also going to add a fast "leakage detector" in the eval harness to fail if >0 overlap in prompt ids between splits before metric computation. Prevents noisy runs from landing.

liam: Can we re-run the failing nightly after the patch lands? If it's indeed leakage we should invalidate the previous quantized-v2 regression and re-run with fixed fixtures.

sophia: Yes please. I'll queue a rerun once PR is merged. Also can someone add a regression test that runs the quantized pipeline on a tiny fixture with fixed seed so we detect this class of issue earlier?

marie: Added that tiny-regression test in PR #241 as well. eval-bot will run it on every PR now.

eval-bot: Re-queued job 4721-rerun with fixtures v2026-02-01-fixed after merge of PR #241. ETA ~25m :hourglass:

perry: After this merges I'll push a small hotfix release to the eval-harness package and tag the quantize experiments to use the fixed harness. Also adding an assertion in runner: if duplicate_prompt_ids: raise RuntimeError('leakage detected')

liam: We should backfill suspicious runs from the last 10 days that used the old generator and mark them as flaky in the dashboard. I'll add a dashboard filter for fixture_version!=v2026-02-01-fixed.

sophia: Perfect. Assigning myself to follow up on backfill and notify product if the quantized-v2 baseline changes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

marie: Thanks all — filed follow-ups: MLENG-542 (backfill), MLENG-543 (dashboard filter), MLENG-544 (leakage detector enhancement).

perry: On it. Will also add logging to capture seed+shard in run metadata so future debugging is easier.

sophia: Great. Closing loop once rerun completes.
